name: Claude Code Base Action
description: Run Claude Code in GitHub Actions workflows

prompt.description: The prompt to send to Claude Code (mutually exclusive with prompt_file)

prompt_file.description: Path to a file containing the prompt to send to Claude Code (mutually exclusive with prompt)

allowed_tools.description: Comma-separated list of allowed tools for Claude Code to use

disallowed_tools.description: Comma-separated list of disallowed tools that Claude Code cannot use

max_turns.description: Maximum number of conversation turns (default: no limit)

mcp_config.description: MCP configuration as JSON string or path to MCP configuration JSON file

settings.description: Claude Code settings as JSON string or path to settings JSON file

model.description: Model to use (provider-specific format required for Bedrock/Vertex)

anthropic_model.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'model' instead. Model to use (provider-specific format required for Bedrock/Vertex)

fallback_model.description: Enable automatic fallback to specified model when default model is unavailable

claude_env.description: Custom environment variables to pass to Claude Code execution (YAML multiline format)

timeout_minutes.description: Timeout in minutes for Claude Code execution

experimental_slash_commands_dir.description: Experimental: Directory containing slash command files to install

anthropic_api_key.description: Anthropic API key (required for direct Anthropic API)

claude_code_oauth_token.description: Claude Code OAuth token (alternative to anthropic_api_key)

use_bedrock.description: Use Amazon Bedrock with OIDC authentication instead of direct Anthropic API

use_vertex.description: Use Google Vertex AI with OIDC authentication instead of direct Anthropic API

use_node_cache.description: Whether to use Node.js dependency caching (set to true only for Node.js projects with lock files)
